run_text_classification: run the TextClassificationPipeline to classify input text and return labeled predictions with confidence scores
identify_language: use the TextClassificationPipeline to identify the language of a text string and return top five predictions
find_nearest_neighbors: call the TextClassificationPipeline to find the five nearest neighbor words for a single input word
review_pipeline_init: review the TextClassificationPipeline initialization that loads model info from the HuggingFace Hub using HfApi
refactor_fasttext_prefix: refactor the FASTTEXT_PREFIX_LENGTH constant to handle fasttext label prefix stripping for language identification output
